comparison.objective: Kit items from bins selected by active pick lights, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Title implies visually cued picking and kitting; body and manipulation rubric are absent. Candidate requires tool alignment, counterholding, fine rotation, locking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Only the title identifies correct light-selected picks; counts, destination, and scoring are missing. Candidate is evaluated by quantified dynamic stopping and retention.
comparison.reason: Light-guided kitting is not plausibly the same tested ability as in-place damper tuning, despite incomplete prior-task details.
